evidence: Built a requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md against all 27 scored/gate criteria. Nearly everything is covered, often with positive controls: stage-by-stage moves and skips (hro_moves); bottom placement and shared manual order, persisted across fresh context and restart (hro_moves, hro_intake_restart step 4 'move E up one place' + restart); Interview places, freed place, put-back + reason + focus (hro_interview_places); reject/blank reason/Hired/reopen-to-origin/reason cleared/undo restores reason (hro_reject_reopen); 409 stale move naming who + live board within 15 s (hro_two_people); bulk all-or-none, board order, places counted for set (hro_bulk), role rule in bulk (hro_manager_roles); undo once, no undo-of-undo, later move supersedes, others' move/reorder/reject/reopen block, note does not block (hro_undo), per-user undo stack (hro_interview_places: Rafael's undo after Mei's later move), undo overfill (hro_interview_places); manager late-stage/own-job rules and notes, observer reads notes (hro_manager_roles); 401/403/404 and staff-action refusal for observer/candidate/anonymous (hro_readonly_roles, hro_candidate, hro_messaging Noor 404); job fields, places 1-50, HM must be HM account, email validity, case-insensitive duplicate, field-level refusal keeping input, seed loaded once (hro_intake_restart); participants, plain text, blank refused, Enter/Shift+Enter, line breaks, empty+focused box (hro_messaging); failed send kept (hro_pol_failed_send); 30-message pages, remaining count, place kept, scrolled-up notice/unread/sending-counts-as-read (hro_long_thread, hro_pol_earlier_place); unread per person, totals, own never unread, seed read markers (Lena = 1), seen rules incl. observer never counts and HM/recruiter (hro_unread_seen); drafts per conversation across views/reload (hro_drafts), across session end with re-sign-in prompt, private from another user, note draft private (hro_pol_session_resume); live-update preservation of open card, note, focus, scroll, reply draft (hro_pol_live_board, hro_pol_live_thread); candidate list, wording table, own data only, response privacy, linked application by email (hro_candidate); desktop look (visual likert). Every 'graded only in X' redirect (pol_live_board, pol_live_thread, pol_failed_send, hro_drafts, hro_undo, hro_activity, hro_readonly_roles, functional prompt.md line 21) points to a criterion that really grades that leg. GAP (Fail): hireops_rules.md section 4 lines 117-118 'The Activity view lists them newest first, for all jobs or one chosen job.' No criterion asserts the all-jobs view. hro_activity (functional/judge.toml line 96) steps 'Read the Activity view, then filter it to this job' but the Bar only requires lines for 'every successful action of this session on the job', newest first, and that 'the filter shows all of this job's lines and only this job's'; nothing requires the unfiltered view to show lines of more than one job. hro_intake_restart reads 'the Activity lines of J1' only; hro_reject_reopen, hro_readonly_roles and hro_candidate use Activity only as a reason source or replay target. Notes (not counted as the Fail): (a) Runtime-contract asks in instruction.md lines 15-17 ('honour PORT', health 'never touches the database', 'start with no shipped database', '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime') are not graded by any judge criterion; test.sh launches with PORT=3000, the same as the default (line 108), and leaves /assets readable (line 88). These are shared runtime policy owned by the frozen harness, rows 4/23 and the deterministic layer, so they are not counted as a row-26 task-criterion gap; they are recorded as unmeasured. (b) Places '1 to 50' are graded through refusals at 0, 51 and 2.5 with 2 as the control; acceptance at exactly 50 is not probed (boundary note, not an ungraded behaviour). (c) The UI-level 'tell me who' on a stale move is graded at response level (hro_two_people accepts 'by name in the response or on screen'), matching rules section 3 'the refusal itself says the card was changed and by whom'; put-back plus on-screen reason is graded once in hro_interview_places, which is one coherent promise, not a gap. Colderwater lessons checked for this row: lesson 1/16 (no criterion removed leaving a brief sentence ungraded except the Activity all-jobs view; no double-grading redirect points to a non-grading criterion), lesson 15 (restart re-reads several recorded items, covered in hro_intake_restart). No runtime run exercised this row; it is a source mapping review.
counterexample: A broken-but-passing app: the Activity view has no all-jobs mode; it always shows the job currently selected on the board (the judge's own new job), newest first, with a job picker. In hro_activity the judge reads the Activity view (it shows only this job's lines), filters to this job (same lines, only this job's), and the Observer reads the same lines, so every leg of the Bar holds and the app earns the full 2.0 weight although the brief's 'for all jobs' listing is missing. No other criterion catches it.
suggested_fix: Add one leg to hro_activity's Bar: before filtering, the unfiltered Activity view also shows a line from another job (for example the global gate's candidate added on the seeded Data Analyst job in this session), and after filtering that line is gone.
